f.title: Investigator: report a UADE to the sponsor and IRB within 10 working days
f.statement: An investigator shall submit to the sponsor and to the reviewing IRB a report of any unanticipated adverse device effect occurring during an investigation as soon as possible, but in no event later than 10 working days after the investigator first learns of the effect.

rows.deadline: As soon as possible, but no later than 10 working days after the investigator first learns of the effect
rows.quote:
(1) Unanticipated adverse device effects.
An investigator shall submit to the
sponsor and to the reviewing IRB a report of any unanticipated adverse device effect occurring during an investigation as soon as possible, but in no
event later than 10 working days after
the investigator first learns of the effect.

deadline_rule.clock_start: the investigator first learns of the effect
deadline_rule.applies_to: Investigator UADE reports to sponsor and IRB

f.title: Investigator: report withdrawal of IRB approval to the sponsor within 5 working days
f.statement: An investigator shall report to the sponsor, within 5 working days, a withdrawal of approval by the reviewing IRB of the investigator's part of an investigation.

rows.quote:
(2) Withdrawal of IRB approval. An investigator shall report to the sponsor,
within 5 working days, a withdrawal of
approval by the reviewing IRB of the
investigator’s part of an investigation.
rows.review_note: Template gaps 2026-11-23, extractor. The text states no explicit clock start; clock_start taken as the withdrawal of approval.

deadline_rule.clock_start: a withdrawal of approval by the reviewing IRB
deadline_rule.applies_to: Investigator report of IRB withdrawal of approval

f.title: Investigator: submit progress reports at least yearly
f.statement: An investigator shall submit progress reports on the investigation to the sponsor, the monitor and the reviewing IRB at regular intervals, but in no event less often than yearly.

rows.deadline: At regular intervals, at least yearly
rows.quote:
(3) Progress. An investigator shall
submit progress reports on the investigation to the sponsor, the monitor,
and the reviewing IRB at regular intervals, but in no event less often than
yearly.

f.title: Investigator: notify emergency deviations to protect a subject within 5 working days
f.statement: An investigator shall notify the sponsor and the reviewing IRB of any deviation from the investigational plan made to protect the life or physical well-being of a subject in an emergency, as soon as possible but in no event later than 5 working days after the emergency occurred.

rows.deadline: As soon as possible, no later than 5 working days after the emergency occurred
rows.quote:
(4) Deviations from the investigational
plan. An investigator shall notify the
sponsor and the reviewing IRB (see
§ 56.108(a) (3) and (4)) of any deviation
from the investigational plan to protect the life or physical well-being of a
subject in an emergency. Such notice
shall be given as soon as possible, but
in no event later than 5 working days
after the emergency occurred.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Emergency deviations from the investigational plan

f.title: Investigator: obtain sponsor (and where needed FDA and IRB) approval before other plan changes or deviations
f.statement: Except in an emergency, prior approval by the sponsor is required for changes in or deviations from the plan, and if they may affect the scientific soundness of the plan or the rights, safety or welfare of subjects, FDA and IRB approval under 812.35(a) is also required.

rows.quote:
Except
in such an emergency, prior approval
by the sponsor is required for changes
in or deviations from a plan, and if
these changes or deviations may affect
the scientific soundness of the plan or
the rights, safety, or welfare of human
subjects, FDA and IRB in accordance
with § 812.35(a) also is required.

f.title: Investigator: report device use without informed consent within 5 working days
f.statement: If an investigator uses a device without obtaining informed consent, the investigator shall report such use to the sponsor and the reviewing IRB within 5 working days after the use occurs.

rows.deadline: Within 5 working days after the use occurs
rows.quote:
(5) Informed consent. If an investigator uses a device without obtaining
informed consent, the investigator
shall report such use to the sponsor
and the reviewing IRB within 5 working days after the use occurs.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Use of a device without informed consent

f.title: Investigator: submit a final report within 3 months of termination or completion
f.statement: An investigator shall, within 3 months after termination or completion of the investigation or the investigator's part of it, submit a final report to the sponsor and the reviewing IRB.

rows.deadline: Within 3 months after termination or completion
rows.quote:
(6) Final report. An investigator shall,
within 3 months after termination or
completion of the investigation or the
investigator’s part of the investigation,
submit a final report to the sponsor
and the reviewing IRB.

deadline_rule.clock_start: termination or completion of the investigation

f.title: Investigator: provide information on request by the IRB or FDA
f.statement: An investigator shall, upon request by a reviewing IRB or FDA, provide accurate, complete and current information about any aspect of the investigation.

rows.quote:

f.statement: A sponsor shall prepare and submit complete, accurate and timely reports as listed in 812.150(b).

f.title: Sponsor: report UADE evaluation results to FDA, IRBs and investigators within 10 working days
f.statement: A sponsor who conducts an evaluation of an unanticipated adverse device effect under 812.46(b) shall report the results to FDA and to all reviewing IRBs and participating investigators within 10 working days after the sponsor first receives notice of the effect.

rows.deadline: Within 10 working days after the sponsor first receives notice of the effect
rows.quote:
(1) Unanticipated adverse device effects.
A sponsor who conducts an evaluation
of an unanticipated adverse device effect under § 812.46(b) shall report the results of such evaluation to FDA and to
all reviewing IRB’s and participating
investigators within 10 working days
after the sponsor first receives notice
of the effect.

deadline_rule.clock_start: the sponsor first receives notice of the effect
deadline_rule.applies_to: Sponsor UADE evaluation reports to FDA, IRBs and investigators

f.title: Sponsor: submit additional UADE reports FDA requests
f.statement: Thereafter the sponsor shall submit such additional reports concerning the unanticipated adverse device effect as FDA requests.

rows.quote:
Thereafter the sponsor
shall submit such additional reports
concerning the effect as FDA requests.

f.title: Sponsor: notify FDA, IRBs and investigators of IRB withdrawal of approval within 5 working days
f.statement: A sponsor shall notify FDA and all reviewing IRBs and participating investigators of any withdrawal of approval of an investigation or part of an investigation by a reviewing IRB within 5 working days after receipt of the withdrawal of approval.

rows.deadline: Within 5 working days after receipt of the withdrawal
rows.quote:
(2) Withdrawal of IRB approval. A
sponsor shall notify FDA and all reviewing IRB’s and participating investigators of any withdrawal of approval
of an investigation or a part of an investigation by a reviewing IRB within
5 working days after receipt of the
withdrawal of approval.

deadline_rule.clock_start: receipt of the withdrawal of approval
deadline_rule.applies_to: Sponsor notice of IRB withdrawal of approval

f.title: Sponsor: notify IRBs and investigators of FDA withdrawal of approval within 5 working days
f.statement: A sponsor shall notify all reviewing IRBs and participating investigators of any withdrawal of FDA approval of the investigation within 5 working days after receipt of notice of the withdrawal.

rows.deadline: Within 5 working days after receipt of notice of the withdrawal
rows.quote:
(3) Withdrawal of FDA approval. A
sponsor shall notify all reviewing IRB’s
and participating investigators of any
withdrawal of FDA approval of the investigation, and shall do so within 5
working days after receipt of notice of
the withdrawal of approval.

deadline_rule.clock_start: receipt of notice of the withdrawal of approval
deadline_rule.applies_to: Sponsor notice of FDA withdrawal of approval

f.title: Sponsor: submit a current investigator list to FDA every 6 months
f.statement: A sponsor shall submit to FDA, at 6-month intervals, a current list of the names and addresses of all investigators participating in the investigation; the first list is due 6 months after FDA approval.

rows.deadline: At 6-month intervals; first list 6 months after FDA approval
rows.quote:
(4) Current investigator list. A sponsor
shall submit to FDA, at 6-month intervals, a current list of the names and
addresses of all investigators participating in the investigation. The sponsor shall submit the first such list 6
months after FDA approval.

deadline_rule.applies_to: First current investigator list (then every 6 months)

f.title: Sponsor: submit progress reports to IRBs at least yearly (and to FDA for significant risk devices)
f.statement: At regular intervals, and at least yearly, a sponsor shall submit progress reports to all reviewing IRBs; for a significant risk device it shall also submit progress reports to FDA.

rows.deadline: At regular intervals, at least yearly
rows.quote:
(5) Progress reports. At regular intervals, and at least yearly, a sponsor
shall submit progress reports to all reviewing IRB’s. In the case of a significant risk device, a sponsor shall also
submit progress reports to FDA.

f.title: Treatment IDE sponsor: submit semi-annual progress reports and annual reports
f.statement: A sponsor of a treatment IDE shall submit semi-annual progress reports to all reviewing IRBs and FDA in accordance with 812.36(f) and annual reports in accordance with 812.150.

rows.quote:
A
sponsor of a treatment IDE shall submit semi-annual progress reports to all
reviewing IRB’s and FDA in accordance
with § 812.36(f) and annual reports in accordance with this section.

f.title: Sponsor: notify FDA and IRBs within 30 working days of a request to return, repair or dispose of devices
f.statement: A sponsor shall notify FDA and all reviewing IRBs of any request that an investigator return, repair or otherwise dispose of any units of a device; the notice shall occur within 30 working days after the request is made and shall state why the request was made.

rows.deadline: Within 30 working days after the request is made
rows.quote:
(6) Recall and device disposition. A
sponsor shall notify FDA and all reviewing IRB’s of any request that an
investigator return, repair, or otherwise dispose of any units of a device.
Such notice shall occur within 30 working days after the request is made and
shall state why the request was made.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Notice of requests to return, repair or dispose of device units

f.title: Significant risk device sponsor: notify FDA within 30 working days of completion or termination
f.statement: In the case of a significant risk device, the sponsor shall notify FDA within 30 working days of the completion or termination of the investigation.

f.statement: In the case of a significant risk device, the sponsor shall submit a final report to FDA and all reviewing IRBs and participating investigators within 6 months after completion or termination.

and shall submit a final

f.title: Non-significant risk device sponsor: submit the final report to IRBs within 6 months
f.statement: In the case of a device that is not a significant risk device, the sponsor shall submit a final report to all reviewing IRBs within 6 months after termination or completion.

f.title: Sponsor: send FDA a copy of an investigator report of device use without consent within 5 working days
f.statement: A sponsor shall submit to FDA a copy of any investigator report under 812.150(a)(5) of use of a device without obtaining informed consent, within 5 working days of receipt of notice of such use.

rows.deadline: Within 5 working days of receipt of notice of the use

f.title: Sponsor: report an IRB significant risk determination to FDA within 5 working days
f.statement: If an IRB determines that a device is a significant risk device and the sponsor had proposed that the IRB consider it not to be, the sponsor shall submit to FDA a report of the IRB's determination within 5 working days after the sponsor first learns of it.

rows.deadline: Within 5 working days after the sponsor first learns of the determination

(9) Significant risk device determinations. If an IRB determines that a device is a significant risk device, and

consider the device not to be a significant risk device, the sponsor shall submit to FDA a report of the IRB’s determination within 5 working days after
the sponsor first learns of the IRB’s determination.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Reports of IRB significant risk determinations
